sources.title: pipecat-examples/phonellm at main · pipecat-ai/pipecat-examples - GitHub
sources.snippet: A JSON response listing pipecat-ai/phonellm-alpha-1 means the endpoint is healthy. Note: Endpoints scale to zero when idle. The first request after creation (or after a quiet period) returns 503 while the model spins up — this can take several minutes for a 30B model, and the container logs (modal app logs) may go quiet during kernel compilation.

sources.snippet: Phonellm Alpha 1 is an open-source 30b LLM by pipecat-ai. VRAM 63.2GB, 256K context. Compare benchmarks, capabilities, and deployment details on LLM Explorer.

sources.title: Announcing Pipecat PhoneLLM Alpha 1 - daily.co
sources.snippet: The Pipecat team is pleased to announce the release of PhoneLLM Alpha 1, an open-weights model for voice agent use cases. This release is the result of our ongoing work training small, open-weights LLMs for low-latency and multi-turn agentic workloads.
